dt_validation.note: |ft of frame showing post(N+s) - dt_est(N)| over grounded commands with post speed >= 150 u/s; dt_est = |po_xy - o_xy| / |pv_xy|

pooled_rates.note: decel pools the standing conditions; crouch is separate

source_friction_best.note: grid stopspeed 0..400 step 10; at the top of the grid the model is constant decel

closed_loop.note: speed RMS / max |error| (u/s) of a closed-loop speed simulation from the press using observed dt and input bits, against observed post speed, to the end of the trial
